title: Orbit Disco
description: An acid-yellow and pink cosmic dance floor with an animated Three.js solar system, eight selectable planets, custom procedural stripes and star field, playful planet descriptions, orbit and zoom controls, pause/resume, adjustable simulation tempo, reset, responsive HTML controls, and a readable WebGL-unavailable fallback.

tests.command: node --input-type=module -e "import { build } from 'vite'; await build({root:'experiments/planetary/sol-medium-bold', configFile:false, build:{write:false}});"
tests.outcome: Passed; exit code 0. Vite 7.3.6 transformed 7 modules and completed the in-memory production bundle in 1.30 seconds.

knownLimitations: Browser and visual interaction checks were not performed; localhost browser access was unavailable as specified.
All planetary scales, colors, distances and motion are explicitly stylized; displayed playground years are simulation seconds, not scientific data.
WebGL availability depends on the viewing browser. If creation fails or the context is lost, the page displays an explanatory fallback and planet information remains accessible.
Reduced-motion preference starts the simulation paused; users may explicitly start it.
